# Idea: widget-marketplace

## Pain & Evidence
Hobbyists repeatedly ask for a central widget marketplace across forums.

## Analogs / Prior Art
General 3D-model marketplaces exist but none focus on this niche.

## Differentiation / USP
Curated, niche-specific catalog with reviewer vetting.

## MVP
A static catalog + a simple upload/checkout flow for digital files.

## Cost (Effort)
Estimated cost: около недели работы одного разработчика на MVP.

## Risks
Low initial supply of listings; competitor could copy the curation angle.

5 Почему, Lean Canvas
